(function(){
  const box = document.getElementById('rbTaxiInline');
  const hide = document.getElementById('rbTaxiInlineHide');
  const restore = document.getElementById('rbTaxiInlineRestore');
  const toggle = document.getElementById('rbTaxiInlineToggle');
  if (!box || !hide || !restore) return;

  const KEY = 'rbTaxiInlineHidden';

  function apply(){
    const hidden = localStorage.getItem(KEY) === '1';
    box.classList.toggle('is-user-hidden', hidden);
    restore.style.display = hidden ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    if (hidden && toggle) toggle.checked = false;
  }

  hide.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, '1');
    apply();
  });

  restore.addEventListener('click', function(){
    localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
    apply();
  });

  apply();
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  function stopCardNavigation(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const thumb = e.target.closest('.rb-home-video-thumb');
    if (!thumb) return;

    const video = thumb.querySelector('video');
    if (!video) return;

    stopCardNavigation(e);

    if (video.paused || video.ended) {
      // The click is a direct user gesture, so sound may be enabled here.
      video.muted = false;
      video.controls = true;

      const playPromise = video.play();
      if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.catch === 'function') {
        playPromise.catch(function () {
          // If a browser still refuses sound autoplay, retry muted.
          video.muted = true;
          video.play().catch(function () {});
        });
      }
    } else {
      video.pause();
    }
  }, true);

  document.addEventListener('play', function (e) {
    if (!(e.target instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;
    const thumb = e.target.closest('.rb-home-video-thumb');
    if (!thumb) return;

    // Stop other homepage previews so only one video plays at a time.
    document.querySelectorAll('.rb-home-video-thumb video').forEach(function (other) {
      if (other !== e.target && !other.paused) other.pause();
    });

    thumb.classList.add('is-playing');
  }, true);

  document.addEventListener('pause', function (e) {
    if (!(e.target instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;
    const thumb = e.target.closest('.rb-home-video-thumb');
    if (thumb) thumb.classList.remove('is-playing');
  }, true);

  document.addEventListener('ended', function (e) {
    if (!(e.target instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;
    const thumb = e.target.closest('.rb-home-video-thumb');
    if (thumb) thumb.classList.remove('is-playing');
  }, true);
})();
</script>

.rb-chat-top-button{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #a7c5ef;background:#eff6ff;color:#153e75;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 11px;font:700 14px Arial,sans-serif}
[data-rb-chat-open]{position:relative}
[data-rb-chat-open].rb-chat-is-online::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:1px;right:1px;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#16a34a;border:2px solid white;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #15803d}
.rb-chat-availability{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;margin-top:5px;color:#e2e8f0}
.rb-chat-availability-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#94a3b8;flex:none}
.rb-chat-availability.online .rb-chat-availability-dot{background:#4ade80}
.rb-chat-top-button:hover,.rb-chat-top-button:focus-visible{background:#dbeafe;outline-offset:3px}
.rb-chat-mobile-button{display:none}
@media(max-width:1023px){.rb-chat-desktop-button{display:none!important}.rb-chat-mobile-button{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid #a7c5ef;border-radius:12px;background:#eff6ff;color:#153e75;padding:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:21px;min-width:40px;min-height:40px;cursor:pointer}}
.rb-chat-dialog[hidden]{display:none!important}.rb-chat-dialog{position:fixed;inset:auto 16px 18px auto;z-index:2147483002;width:min(380px,calc(100vw - 24px));height:min(570px,calc(100dvh - 32px));display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #0f172a40;direction:rtl;text-align:right;font:15px Arial,sans-serif;color:#172033}
.rb-chat-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 16px;background:#153e75;color:white;border-radius:15px 15px 0 0}.rb-chat-head button{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:0;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer;min-width:35px;min-height:35px}
.rb-chat-messages{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-height:70px}.rb-chat-bubble{max-width:85%;padding:9px 12px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;border-radius:12px;background:#edf2f7;align-self:flex-start}.rb-chat-bubble.mine{background:#dbeafe;align-self:flex-end}
.rb-chat-form{border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;padding:12px;display:grid;gap:8px}.rb-chat-form input,.rb-chat-form textarea,.rb-chat-form select{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid #94a3b8;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;font:inherit}.rb-chat-form textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:52px;max-height:110px}.rb-chat-form button{background:#153e75;color:white;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;cursor:pointer}.rb-chat-form button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}.rb-chat-error{color:#b91c1c;font-size:13px;min-height:16px}.rb-chat-intro{padding:12px;background:#f8fafc;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:640px){.rb-chat-dialog{inset:auto 8px 8px 8px;width:auto;height:min(530px,calc(100dvh - 16px))}}
</style>
<section id="rbChatDialog" class="rb-chat-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="false" aria-labelledby="rbChatHeading" hidden>
 <div class="rb-chat-head"><div><strong id="rbChatHeading">💬 צ׳אט פרסום עם בעל האתר</strong><div id="rbChatAvailability" class="rb-chat-availability" role="status"><span class="rb-chat-availability-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span><span id="rbChatAvailabilityText">בודקים זמינות…</span></div></div><button id="rbChatClose" type="button" aria-label="סגירת הצ׳אט">×</button></div>
 <div class="rb-chat-intro">מעוניינים בפרסום בתשלום, מודעה מקודמת או באנר? כתבו לנו כאן. התשובה תופיע בשיחה זו כל עוד החלון פתוח.</div>
 <div id="rbChatMessages" class="rb-chat-messages" aria-live="polite" aria-relevant="additions"></div>
 <form class="rb-chat-form" id="rbChatForm">
  <div id="rbChatIdentity"><label for="rbChatName">שם</label><input id="rbChatName" name="name" maxlength="100" required autocomplete="name"><label for="rbChatPhone">טלפון (לא חובה)</label><input id="rbChatPhone" name="phone" type="tel" maxlength="30" autocomplete="tel"><label for="rbChatSubject">במה נוכל לעזור?</label><select id="rbChatSubject" name="subject"><option>פרסום מודעה מקודמת</option><option>פרסום עסק או באנר</option><option>ייעוץ לגבי אפשרויות פרסום</option><option>אחר</option></select></div>
  <label for="rbChatBody">ההודעה שלך</label><textarea id="rbChatBody" name="body" maxlength="2000" required placeholder="כתבו כאן..." ></textarea><div id="rbChatError" class="rb-chat-error" role="status"></div><button type="submit">שליחת הודעה</button>
 </form>
</section>
<script>
(()=>{
const api='/reshut-harabim/rb-live-chat.php', dialog=document.getElementById('rbChatDialog'), form=document.getElementById('rbChatForm'), messages=document.getElementById('rbChatMessages'), identity=document.getElementById('rbChatIdentity'), error=document.getElementById('rbChatError');
let csrf='',after=0,timer=null,hasThread=false,loading=false;
let visitorToken='';
try{const saved=localStorage.getItem('rb_chat_visitor_token')||'';if(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(saved))visitorToken=saved;}catch(e){}
function tokenQuery(){return visitorToken?'&visitor_token='+encodeURIComponent(visitorToken):'';}
function saveToken(t){if(!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(t||''))return;visitorToken=t;try{localStorage.setItem('rb_chat_visitor_token',t);}catch(e){}}
async function updateAvailability(){
 try{
  const j=await fetchJson(api+'?action=availability');if(!j.ok)throw Error('Unavailable');
  const online=!!j.online;
  document.getElementById('rbChatAvailability').classList.toggle('online',online);
  document.getElementById('rbChatAvailabilityText').textContent=online?'\u05DE\u05D7\u05D5\u05D1\u05E8 \u05DB\u05E2\u05EA \u2013 \u05E0\u05D9\u05EA\u05DF \u05DC\u05E9\u05D5\u05D7\u05D7 \u05D0\u05D9\u05EA\u05E0\u05D5':'\u05DC\u05D0 \u05D6\u05DE\u05D9\u05E0\u05D9\u05DD \u05DB\u05E8\u05D2\u05E2 \u2013 \u05D0\u05E4\u05E9\u05E8 \u05DC\u05D4\u05E9\u05D0\u05D9\u05E8 \u05D4\u05D5\u05D3\u05E2\u05D4';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-rb-chat-open]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('rb-chat-is-online',online));
 }catch(e){document.getElementById('rbChatAvailability').classList.remove('online');document.getElementById('rbChatAvailabilityText').textContent='\u05D0\u05E4\u05E9\u05E8 \u05DC\u05D4\u05E9\u05D0\u05D9\u05E8 \u05DC\u05E0\u05D5 \u05D4\u05D5\u05D3\u05E2\u05D4';document.querySelectorAll('[data-rb-chat-open]').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('rb-chat-is-online'));}
}
updateAvailability();setInterval(updateAvailability,20000);
async function fetchJson(url,options){const r=await fetch(url,{credentials:'same-origin',cache:'no-store',...options});return r.json();}
function append(m){const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='rb-chat-bubble'+(m.sender==='visitor'?' mine':'');el.textContent=m.body;messages.appendChild(el);messages.scrollTop=messages.scrollHeight;after=Math.max(after,Number(m.id));}
async function poll(){if(dialog.hidden||loading)return;loading=true;try{const result=await fetchJson(api+'?action=messages&after='+after+tokenQuery());if(result.ok){result.messages.forEach(append);if(result.messages.length){hasThread=true;identity.hidden=true;document.getElementById('rbChatName').required=false;}}}catch(e){}finally{loading=false;}}
async function open(){updateAvailability();dialog.hidden=false;document.getElementById('rbChatClose').focus();try{const result=await fetchJson(api+'?action=csrf'+tokenQuery());csrf=result.csrf||'';saveToken(result.visitor_token||'');}catch(e){error.textContent='\u05DC\u05D0 \u05E0\u05D9\u05EA\u05DF \u05DC\u05D4\u05EA\u05D7\u05D1\u05E8 \u05DB\u05E8\u05D2\u05E2';}await poll();clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(poll,3000);}
function close(){dialog.hidden=true;clearInterval(timer);timer=null;}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-rb-chat-open]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',open));document.getElementById('rbChatClose').addEventListener('click',close);
form.addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();error.textContent='';const button=form.querySelector('button[type=submit]');button.disabled=true;try{if(!csrf){const c=await fetchJson(api+'?action=csrf'+tokenQuery());csrf=c.csrf||'';saveToken(c.visitor_token||'');}const payload=new FormData(form);payload.set('action','send');payload.set('csrf',csrf);if(visitorToken)payload.set('visitor_token',visitorToken);const result=await fetchJson(api,{method:'POST',body:payload});if(!result.ok)throw Error(result.error||'\u05DC\u05D0 \u05E0\u05D9\u05EA\u05DF \u05DC\u05E9\u05DC\u05D5\u05D7 \u05D0\u05EA \u05D4\u05D4\u05D5\u05D3\u05E2\u05D4');form.querySelector('textarea').value='';hasThread=true;identity.hidden=true;document.getElementById('rbChatName').required=false;await poll();}catch(err){error.textContent=err.message||'\u05E9\u05D2\u05D9\u05D0\u05EA \u05EA\u05E7\u05E9\u05D5\u05E8\u05EA';}finally{button.disabled=false;}});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
